title: Persist validated local image assets
description: Validate imported image files, copy supported bytes into IndexedDB as durable asset records, and resolve content references offline without external URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported image imports are checked for declared type, decoded type, dimensions, byte limit, and integrity before persistence
Accepted bytes are copied into an AssetRecord with durable identity, media type, dimensions, integrity data, and timestamps
Image nodes persist only durable asset identity and never an external or object URL
An imported asset resolves after reload while offline
Missing, mismatched, executable, malformed, or oversized assets return named diagnostics without partial persistence

steps.details: Select the supported raster formats and conservative size/dimension limits, then validate file signature, decoded metadata, and integrity before storage.
Reuse the existing IndexedDB transaction layer to atomically store immutable copied bytes and metadata under an application-owned durable identifier.
Resolve image node asset IDs to validated local bytes for scene generation and return element-specific missing/integrity diagnostics without network fallback.
Import a small fixture, reload in an offline browser context, verify identical bytes resolve, and cover malformed, missing, oversized, and unsupported fixtures.

technicalNotes: Timebox to one supported image import path plus refusal fixtures; bounded downsampling or additional formats require separate work.
Never decode SVG or another executable-capable format as a trusted durable image in this slice.
